$comment: Project settings for the technical-team plugin. Only you edit this file; team agents are told never to write .claude/. skills: per-role lists of skills an agent may load with the Skill tool (project skills by name, plugin skills as <plugin>:<skill>); the lead names the fitting ones in each brief; run-kit is always available, and so is the plugin skill live-preview for qa, developer and designer. Put the UI/UX design skills you install (e.g. from GitHub) under skills.team-designer and the matching frontend skills under skills.team-developer. externalAgents: non-team agents the lead may call for read-only context (default ["Explore"]). Set [] to turn it off.
